text:
Coordinator: Reminder for the Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways: safety beats speed on every leg.  
Planner: Share practical instructions with the crews so Milo can stay calm through each handoff.  
Handler: The care plan should cover species, temperament, and comfort, then match the cabin setup.  
Lounge Liaison: Caldreth means the pet-lounge management role, handled by Elara Voss in plain terms.  
Trainer: Assign a familiar routine before departure, and double-check leash or carrier security.  
Scheduler: Coordinate with ramp staff to minimize waiting, but keep movement smooth and predictable.  
Quality Lead: Confirm crew briefing includes hydration pauses, quiet handling, and gentle transitions.  
Coordinator: Log any changes in behavior, then adjust the comfort steps without rushing.  
Planner: Keep monitoring until arrival, then guide the traveler to the correct follow-up care path.
